reason: The lettuce is ready, so scissors should let me harvest it for a first taste.
expectation: I expect to cut some lettuce, perhaps before washing or eating it.

alternatives.reason: The mesh and tool may make support for potatoes, but I want to harvest the ready crop first.

effect: The harvest produced leaves as expected; I can prepare them for eating.
reaction: A straightforward, satisfying first harvest after the earlier sowing.
reason: Water should rinse the fresh leaves before the galley.
expectation: I expect washed lettuce ready to eat or prepare.

alternatives.reason: I still want to address the potato bed, but will finish the harvest first.

effect: The leaves are washed, so the galley is the natural next destination.
reaction: The rinse was predictable and practical, though not surprising.
reason: I want to taste the harvest and the galley is where it can be prepared.
expectation: I expect the lettuce to become a meal or tasting portion.

alternatives.reason: That may prepare potato support; I prefer to finish the lettuce first.

effect: The first meal completes the harvest goal; I can now focus on the potatoes.
reaction: The green smell against the bare view makes the meal feel tangible and earned.
reason: This is the only available combination and may shape the mesh to give stems room.
expectation: I expect a cut or shaped mesh support for the potato trough, though I am guessing about its form.

effect: The mesh became a cage, confirming its purpose as plant support.
reaction: The transformation makes practical sense, although the single available action made it easy to follow.
reason: Fit the cage to the potato trough so the stems have support and space.
expectation: I expect the cage to be installed and the potato goal completed.

effect: The supported trough completes the remaining goal while the potatoes continue growing.
reaction: The image of leaves above a dark cover and tubers still a promise gives the chapter a quiet sense of time passing.

mostWorthwhile.text: The first fresh meal was most worthwhile: its sharp green smell and the empty view outside made the growing work feel personal and tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Rinsing the leaves was sensible but a routine transition with little to discover.

surprise.text: The cage was a plausible use of cargo mesh, though I had only guessed at its form; the contrast of green leaves and the dark root cover gave the potato bed a clear image.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the mesh combination was initially a guess prompted by compatibility, and its support purpose became clear afterward.

continue.text: Yes. The sensory payoff of the meal and the promise of the growing potatoes make me curious to see what happens next, though the decisions here were fairly straightforward.
